date_split_note: date_split in every setting: 'before' = days to 2025-10-31, 'from' = days from 2025-11-03 (quote sizes are divided by 100 from that day); each part has its own bootstrap. The development period has no day from 2025-11-03.

daily_file.name: study21_daily.csv
daily_file.empty_columns: control rows have no market-order columns (trades_M, M_L3D1, M_L0D0): control pairs are valued at mids only

data_note_sizes: quote sizes are divided by 100 from 2025-11-03 (the SIPs report shares instead of round lots from that day); round lots are reassigned on the first business day of May and November (2026-11-02: MPC, QQQM, VLO from 100 to 40 shares), the unit is unchanged
data_note_a1: SPY and QQQ were used in research 1 and LastHalfHour; the rules of study 21 were not set from that data (SPEC21_ANSWERS A1)
not_included: quotes, trades, bars, per-order and per-trade data
